scope: Bounded paid model execution against a copied public Java package and planted single-bug Java fixtures. Not production acceptance, a full-project audit, a model-accuracy benchmark, an invoice or live customer-integration qualification.

budget.scope: One shared approval across all qualification requests, not a new allowance per case.
controls: Only the approved model is admitted by a local budget proxy.
Provider credentials remain in the proxy process, outside the qualification CLI and its tool subprocesses; those clients receive a dummy local proxy key.
No provider or model fallback is admitted.
Requests reserve a conservative amount before provider forwarding, including in-flight reservations.

snapshotBeforeContainerExperiment.rejectionReason: paid_call_limit: the initial local 40-call ceiling; rejected requests were not forwarded.
snapshotBeforeContainerExperiment.scope: This is the completed snapshot before the separate model-plus-container experiment. It is not the final qualification-session total.

finalLedger.scope: Final stopped proxy ledger including the later model-plus-container fixture. No further paid requests are included after the stop.

accounting.note: Conservative request reservations and the proxy upper estimate are budget-control bounds, separate from the standard token-cost estimate. Reported token usage is not confirmation of a billed-dollar amount.

source.commitVerification: All 42 manifest hashes independently matched git-show blobs at the stated public upstream commit.

runtimeEvidence.businessContext: The operationally-critical tag and exact operator note were present in both persisted initial prompts; zero findings left no finding-level context/ranking result to verify.

keycloakAudit.independentReview: Coverage report, SQLite coverage ledger, both persisted sessions, all 42 copied source hashes and all 42 upstream git objects at the stated commit were inspected. The per-request standard formula matched the runtime/report/database estimate.
limits: The source is a standalone copied package with no git metadata, build files, dependency manifests or surrounding application callers.
No build or runtime exploit replay was performed for this source-copy audit.
Zero findings does not establish vulnerability absence, production exploitability, model precision/recall or full Keycloak coverage.

initialJavaFixFixtureRuns.reportedResult: All four initial runs committed a change, compiled, passed the original fixture tests and blocked the separate exploit check under the harness scoring rules. This was limited fixture evidence, not approval of every generated patch.

cases.laterCompatibilityReview: The generated patch failed three additional compatibility checks; the initial limited-test success is not production acceptance.

initialJavaFixFixtureRuns.testEditDisclosure: The model edited test files in every initial case. Scoring restored and ran the original fixture tests; test edits were disclosed rather than counted as unexpected files.
initialJavaFixFixtureRuns.rescanLimit: Only command-injection and XXE were eligible for original-finding rescan scoring. The command-injection run retained one additional scanner finding. No claim that every patched fixture was free of scanner findings is made.
initialJavaFixFixtureRuns.limits: Planted, small single-bug repositories with one attempt each; no production repository, private registry, merge acceptance or general fix-success rate established.

strengthenedDeserializationRerun.trigger: Review of the initial generated fix found three compatibility regressions: a null username, a long Unicode username and a previously serialized legitimate cookie.
strengthenedDeserializationRerun.fixtureChange: The committed fixture tests now retain the three compatibility controls. The reference implementation was unchanged and validated against the strengthened tests. The long username has 40000 characters and 80000 UTF-8 bytes; the retained-cookie control uses the original serialization format.
strengthenedDeserializationRerun.testEditDisclosure: The rerun also edited a test file; scoring restored the strengthened original tests before evaluating the patch.
strengthenedDeserializationRerun.limits: This corrects the fixture evidence for one rerun. It does not make the original defective fix acceptable or establish production compatibility beyond the tested controls.

supportingCodeChecks.scope: Focused and static scopes overlap earlier regression groups; do not add them together as unique tests. The initial scan reasoning-field failure was corrected and is separate from the completed Keycloak rerun.

outstanding: Full-project agent coverage and labelled model accuracy/false-positive measurements.
End-to-end remediation on representative production Java projects with build, exploit, regression and rescan evidence.
Live Bitbucket, Jenkins, identity-provider, private-registry and cloud/model-service qualification.

javaContainerFixture.case: lexical path containment in a small Maven/JDK21 fixture
observedChecks: Online Maven dependency:go-offline verify setup completed before the verification checks.
The network-off canary reported only the loopback interface.
Offline mvn verify compiled the Java21 fixture and reported 3 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped.
javaContainerFixture.scope: Model-generated fix plus actual Docker/Maven execution. The CLI verifier sandbox covers its check commands, not the whole fixing model runtime. This fixture checks lexical containment; symlink containment is outside scope.

independentPostFixControls.originalPomAndTests: Restored exact baseline POM and test source into a separate candidate copy; SHA256 hashes verified.
independentPostFixControls.cleanup: Only the owned Maven cache and sandbox scratch/containers were removed. No owned native console process remained. Default VM, images, global context, retained source, model branch and reports were unchanged.

realDocker.scope: Four reproduction read-only tests and two Maven OCI runner tests with actual positive/negative, network, tmpfs and noexec controls.

documentation.agentsRoute: Old redirect removed; the actual Claude Code/Codex page title and non-redirect content were asserted.

laterIntegrationValidation.scope: These non-model regression scopes overlap previous runs; no unique aggregate is asserted. Later upstream features and subsequent financial follow-up fixes are not paid-qualified by the bb7bf model evidence.

sourceCheckpointDefinition: Checkpoint for the corrected scan transport and strengthened fixture; the initial fixture revision is recorded separately.

focusedTests.scope: 413 distinct tests in these scopes; overlaps earlier validation groups.

postVariantIntegrationValidation.behavior: Follow-up variant threads share the remaining command budget. Known costs and tokens are aggregated; incomplete totals remain unknown and unavailable costs stop further paid launches. Single-fix benchmarks explicitly disable variant hunts.
postVariantIntegrationValidation.limits: Receipt-based estimated-spend gates can overshoot in flight; these later code changes were regression-tested without additional paid requests and are not part of the bb7bf model snapshot.
